records.description: Comma-separated list of records. Can be emails, MAIDs, or IDFAs. Emails must be lowercase and can be plain text or hashed using SHA1, SHA256, or MD5. Example: "email1@example.com,email2@example.com"

operation_type.description: Operation type for the segment. Use UPDATE to modify audience_ids, or REMOVE to delete the segment.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to include in the customer segment. Only applicable for UPDATE operations.

success.description: Whether all segment updates were accepted.

bid.description: Deprecated. Keyword custom bid in microcurrency.

operation_type.description: Operation type. Use UPDATE to modify, REMOVE to archive/delete the template.

created_time.description: Pin creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds

updated_time.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds

syncs.description: Sync campaign-level analytics as a rolling date-window snapshot
syncs.name: analytics

id.description: The unique identifier of the Pin, e.g. 1099300590356451849

board_id.description: The board to which this Pin belongs, e.g. 1099300658984851677

created_at.description: The date and time when the Pin was created, in ISO 8601 format

link.description: The URL the Pin links to

parent_pin_id.description: The source Pin id if this Pin was saved from another Pin
